clips.title: The story
paras: Dolanaar is a tranquil night elf settlement nestled in the central-eastern boughs of Teldrassil. Situated just southwest of Shadowglen, it serves as the first true town young kal'dorei encounter after departing their sheltered training grounds. Here, rangers, druids, and craftsmen gather to guide newcomers and address the strange, encroaching afflictions disturbing the World Tree.

Resting beneath the lush canopy southwest of Shadowglen, Dolanaar serves as a vital crossway for travelers traversing Teldrassil. Built in the traditional night elven manner, its homes and platforms sit seamlessly woven into the woodland. The village provides newcomers with their first comprehensive training in trades, martial arts, and nature crafts, and sits on the road to the capital city of Darnassus. Because of its central location, reports of corrupted wildlife, aggressive furbolgs, and foul mosses from the surrounding boughs inevitably find their way into Dolanaar's council.
